description: This file defines various template metaprogramming utilities and type traits within the Thunder namespace, including mechanisms for selecting types, inspecting function signatures, and checking for member or static function availability. It is a utility header for type introspection and compile-time checks.

classes.name: pick
classes.description: Template struct to select the type at a given index from a parameter pack.

classes.name: func_traits
classes.description: Template struct to extract function signature details from various callable types.

classes.name: lambda_traits
classes.description: Alias template to obtain function traits from lambda expressions.

classes.name: sign
classes.description: Template struct to determine if a type is signed.

classes.name: same_or_inherits
classes.description: Template struct to check if two types are the same or if one inherits from the other.

methods.name: EnableIfParameter
methods.description: Type alias for std::enable_if based on a boolean parameter.

methods.name: pick
methods.description: Type trait to select the type at a specific index from a variadic template parameter pack.

methods.name: func_traits
methods.description: Extracts return type, class type, and argument types from function pointers, member functions, and std::function objects.

methods.name: lambda_traits
methods.description: Alias to obtain function traits from lambda expressions.

methods.name: same_or_inherits
methods.description: Checks if two types are the same or if one inherits from the other.
